title: Greetings
description: Open and close a conversation without sounding like a textbook.

options: Mi theek aahe, dhanyavaad.
Maza naav Rohit aahe.
Mi Punyat rahato.
questions.correctAnswer: Mi theek aahe, dhanyavaad.
questions.translatedSentence: I am fine, thank you.

options: How are you?
Where are you?
Who are you?
questions.correctAnswer: How are you?

options: Kahi vishesh nahi.
Ho, mala mahit aahe.
Nahi, mi ghari jato.
questions.correctAnswer: Kahi vishesh nahi.
questions.translatedSentence: Nothing much.

options: I am great, what about you?
I am busy, call me later.
I am tired, let me sleep.
questions.correctAnswer: I am great, what about you?

options: Mi bara aahe, tu kasa aahes?
Mala chaha pahije.
Maze ghar ithech aahe.
questions.correctAnswer: Mi bara aahe, tu kasa aahes?
questions.translatedSentence: I am well, how are you?

options: What is your name?
What is your work?
Where is your house?
questions.correctAnswer: What is your name?

options: Maze naav Aarti aahe.
Mi theek aahe, tu bol.
Mi Nagpurla jato aahe.
questions.correctAnswer: Maze naav Aarti aahe.
questions.translatedSentence: My name is Aarti.

options: It was a pleasure to meet you.
It was a pleasure to help you.
It was nice to hear from you.
questions.correctAnswer: It was a pleasure to meet you.

options: Sagle mast aahet, dhanyavaad.
Maze ghar khup motha aahe.
Mi ata ghari nahi aahe.
questions.correctAnswer: Sagle mast aahet, dhanyavaad.
questions.translatedSentence: Everyone at home is doing great, thank you.

options: Ho, mala cutting chai chalel.
Nahi, mi ratri jevat nahi.
Ho, maze naav Rohit aahe.
questions.correctAnswer: Ho, mala cutting chai chalel.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, a cutting chai would be great.

options: Good night, sleep well.
Good morning, get up early.
Good evening, come inside.
questions.correctAnswer: Good night, sleep well.

options: Dhanyavaad, tumche ghar chaan aahe.
Mala udya yeta yenar nahi.
Nahi, mi ata nighato.
questions.correctAnswer: Dhanyavaad, tumche ghar chaan aahe.
questions.translatedSentence: Thank you, your home is lovely.

options: I get up early in the morning.
I go to sleep early at night.
I eat my lunch late in the afternoon.
questions.correctAnswer: I get up early in the morning.

options: Divas chaan gela, dhanyavaad.
Ratri khup thandi hoti.
Sakali mala vel nahi.
questions.correctAnswer: Divas chaan gela, dhanyavaad.
questions.translatedSentence: The day went well, thank you.

questions.sentence: Aat ya, baher khup oon aahe.
options: Come inside, it is very sunny out there.
Go outside, it is very cold in here.
Sit down, the food is almost ready.
questions.correctAnswer: Come inside, it is very sunny out there.

options: Shubh ratri, udya bhetu.
Shubh prabhat, chaha ghya.
Ya, aat basa.
questions.correctAnswer: Shubh ratri, udya bhetu.
questions.translatedSentence: Good night, see you tomorrow.

questions.sentence: Aamchya ghari tumche nehmi swagat aahe.
options: You are always welcome at our home.
You are always late to our home.
You are always busy at your office.
questions.correctAnswer: You are always welcome at our home.

options: Dhanyavaad, ithe khup chaan vatate.
Nahi, mala he ghar mahit nahi.
Ho, mi sakali lavkar uthto.
questions.correctAnswer: Dhanyavaad, ithe khup chaan vatate.
questions.translatedSentence: Thank you, it feels really lovely here.

options: Kahi harkat nahi, he tar maze kaam.
Mala pan thodi madat pahije aahe.
Mi tumhala olakhat nahi.
questions.correctAnswer: Kahi harkat nahi, he tar maze kaam.
questions.translatedSentence: Not at all, this was simply my job.

options: Sorry, I am late.
Thanks, I am ready.
Excuse me, I am lost.
questions.correctAnswer: Sorry, I am late.

options: Saral ja, station davikade aahe.
Mala station khup avadate.
Ho, mi rojach train ne jato.
questions.correctAnswer: Saral ja, station davikade aahe.
questions.translatedSentence: Go straight, the station is on your left.

options: Please give me some water.
Please take some water from me.
Please drink a little water now.
questions.correctAnswer: Please give me some water.

questions.sentence: Sorry, mi chukun tumchya paayavar paay dila.
options: Kahi harkat nahi, jau dya.
Ho, mala te khup avadate.
Dhanyavaad, tumhi khup chaan aahat.
questions.correctAnswer: Kahi harkat nahi, jau dya.
questions.translatedSentence: No problem, let it go.

questions.sentence: Tumchya madati baddal mi khup aabhari aahe.
options: I am very grateful for your help.
I am very late because of your help.
I am very tired after helping you.
questions.correctAnswer: I am very grateful for your help.

questions.sentence: Mala udya yeta yenar nahi, kshama kara.
options: Kahi harkat nahi, punha keva tari bheta.
Dhanyavaad, mi pan udya yeto.
Ho, mi tithech thambto.
questions.correctAnswer: Kahi harkat nahi, punha keva tari bheta.
questions.translatedSentence: No problem, come and meet me some other time.

questions.sentence: Jara baju la vha, mala jaayche aahe.
options: Please move aside, I need to get through.
Please sit down, I want to talk to you.
Please wait here, I will be right back.
questions.correctAnswer: Please move aside, I need to get through.

options: Jau dya, ata visrun ja.
Dhanyavaad, mala te aavadle.
Ho, mi tumchi vaat pahato.
questions.correctAnswer: Jau dya, ata visrun ja.
questions.translatedSentence: Let it be, forget about it now.

options: Barr, kalji ghya, punha bheta.
Ho, mi ata jevayla basto.
Nahi, mala ajun ushir zala nahi.
questions.correctAnswer: Barr, kalji ghya, punha bheta.
questions.translatedSentence: All right, take care and do visit again.

options: Let us meet at the office tomorrow morning.
Let us meet at the station tomorrow evening.
Let us talk on the phone tomorrow night.
questions.correctAnswer: Let us meet at the office tomorrow morning.

options: Sambhalun ja, kalji ghya.
Ho, Mumbai ithun khup lamb aahe.
Nahi, mala Mumbai mahit nahi.
questions.correctAnswer: Sambhalun ja, kalji ghya.
questions.translatedSentence: Travel safely and take care.

questions.sentence: Punha bhetu, tumhala bhetun chaan vatle.
options: See you again, it was lovely meeting you.
See you tomorrow, it was a very long day.
Come again, the food was really lovely.
questions.correctAnswer: See you again, it was lovely meeting you.

options: Ho chalel, mi vaat pahato.
Nahi, maza phone ghari aahe.
Ho, mi ata zopayla jato.
questions.correctAnswer: Ho chalel, mi vaat pahato.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes that works, I will be waiting.

questions.sentence: Nighayachi vel zali, mi jato ata.
options: It is time to leave, I am going now.
It is time to eat, I am hungry now.
It is time to begin, I am ready now.
questions.correctAnswer: It is time to leave, I am going now.

options: Purna athavda mi Punyat aahe, keva pan ya.
Mala kal bhetayla vel navhta.
Ho, mi station var ubha aahe.
questions.correctAnswer: Purna athavda mi Punyat aahe, keva pan ya.
questions.translatedSentence: I am in Pune all week, so come over any time.

options: Message me once you reach home.
Call me before you leave home.
Meet me when you reach the station.
questions.correctAnswer: Message me once you reach home.

options: Ya, punha nakki ya.
Nahi, mala ajun basayche aahe.
Ho, mala khup bhuk lagli aahe.
questions.correctAnswer: Ya, punha nakki ya.
questions.translatedSentence: Goodbye, and do come again.

questions.sentence: Ajoba, tumhi ithe basa, mi ubha rahato.
options: Are nako, tu bas, mi theek aahe.
Ho, mi ithech ubha rahato.
Nahi, mala basayla aavadat nahi.
questions.correctAnswer: Are nako, tu bas, mi theek aahe.
questions.translatedSentence: Oh no, you sit down, I am fine.

questions.sentence: Mothya mansanshi nehmi tumhi mhanun bolave.
options: You should always address elders with the polite form.
You should always speak to elders in a loud voice.
You should never speak to elders about your work.
questions.correctAnswer: You should always address elders with the polite form.

questions.sentence: Kaku, mi tumchi pishvi uchlu ka?
options: Ho re, uchal, ti khup jad aahe.
Nahi, mi pishvi vikat ghetli nahi.
Ho, mala bazarat jayla aavadte.
questions.correctAnswer: Ho re, uchal, ti khup jad aahe.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes dear, please carry it, it is very heavy.

questions.sentence: Mitranshi mi tu mhanto, pan shikshakanshi tumhi mhanto.
options: I say tu to friends, but I say tumhi to teachers.
I speak Marathi with friends, but English with teachers.
I meet my friends daily, but my teachers rarely.
questions.correctAnswer: I say tu to friends, but I say tumhi to teachers.

questions.sentence: Tai, ha number tumcha aahe ka?
options: Ho, majhach aahe, khup dhanyavaad.
Nahi, mala number athvat nahi kaaran mi visarle.
Ho, mi tumhala kal phone kela hota.
questions.correctAnswer: Ho, majhach aahe, khup dhanyavaad.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, that one is mine, thank you so much.

questions.sentence: Samorchi vyakti olkhichi nasel tar nehmi tumhi vapra.
options: If the person is a stranger, always use tumhi.
If the person is a close friend, always use tumhi.
If the person is in a hurry, always wait for them.
questions.correctAnswer: If the person is a stranger, always use tumhi.

questions.sentence: Kaka, mala thoda rasta vicharaycha hota.
options: Vichara na, mi sangto tumhala.
Mi ha rasta rojach vaparto.
Ho, mi ithech javal rahato.
questions.correctAnswer: Vichara na, mi sangto tumhala.
questions.translatedSentence: Go ahead and ask, I will tell you.

questions.sentence: Mothya mansana namaskar kela ki tyanna bar vatate.
options: Elders feel good when you greet them respectfully.
Elders feel tired when you visit them without notice.
Elders feel proud when you speak English well.
questions.correctAnswer: Elders feel good when you greet them respectfully.

options: Ho beta, mi atach jevle, tu jevun ghe.
Nahi, mala amti bhat karta yet nahi.
Ho, mi udya sagalyanna jevan banavte.
questions.correctAnswer: Ho beta, mi atach jevle, tu jevun ghe.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes dear, I just ate, now you go and eat.

questions.sentence: Are, kiti divsani bhetlas! Kuthe hotas evdhe divas?
options: Mi Nagpurla hoto kaaran tithe maze kaam sampat navhte.
Mi rojach ithe yeto, pan tu mala disat nahis.
Mala tuze naav ajun athvat aahe.
questions.correctAnswer: Mi Nagpurla hoto kaaran tithe maze kaam sampat navhte.
questions.translatedSentence: I was in Nagpur because my work there just would not finish.

questions.sentence: Khup divsani bhetlo, pan tu agdi tasach aahes.
options: We have met after a long time, but you are exactly the same.
We met only yesterday, but you did not say a word.
We met at the station, but I did not recognise you.
questions.correctAnswer: We have met after a long time, but you are exactly the same.

questions.sentence: Ghari sagle kase aahet? Kaku bari aahet na?
options: Sagle mast aahet, kaku pan ata bari aahet.
Ghar khup june aahe, pan aamhi tithech rahato.
Mi ghari khup kami vel asto.
questions.correctAnswer: Sagle mast aahet, kaku pan ata bari aahet.
questions.translatedSentence: Everyone is doing great, and aunty is much better now too.

questions.sentence: Mi rojach local ne office la jato, pan sakali gardi khup aste.
options: I take the local train to work every day, but it is very crowded in the morning.
I go to work by bus every day, because the train is far too expensive.
I travel to Pune every weekend, but I never take the local train.
questions.correctAnswer: I take the local train to work every day, but it is very crowded in the morning.

questions.sentence: Chal, ek cutting chai ghyu ani nivant bolu.
options: Chalel, mala pan tula khup kahi sangaycha aahe.
Nahi, mi chai kadhich pilo nahi.
Ho, mi ghari jaun chai banavto.
questions.correctAnswer: Chalel, mala pan tula khup kahi sangaycha aahe.
questions.translatedSentence: Sounds good, I have a lot to tell you as well.

questions.sentence: Tuza mulga ata motha zala asel, nahi ka?
options: Your son must be all grown up by now, is he not?
Your son must be on his way home now, is he not?
Your son was very small the last time I saw him.
questions.correctAnswer: Your son must be all grown up by now, is he not?

questions.sentence: Udya ghari ye, aai puran poli karnar aahe.
options: Nakki yeto, mi kadhich puran poli khalli nahi.
Mala puran poli chi recipe mahit aahe.
Aai udya bazarat jate ka?
questions.correctAnswer: Nakki yeto, mi kadhich puran poli khalli nahi.
questions.translatedSentence: I will definitely come, I have never eaten puran poli.

questions.sentence: Evdha vel zala tari tu mala phone ka kela nahis?
options: Why did you not call me even after all this time?
Why did you call me so late at night?
Why do you never pick up my calls?
questions.correctAnswer: Why did you not call me even after all this time?

questions.sentence: Chal, mi nighto, pan ata sampark thevu ha.
options: Nakki, ata mi tula darr mahinyala phone karen.
Ho, pan mala tuze navin ghar mahit nahi.
Barr, mi udya sakali Sahyadrit trek la jato.
questions.correctAnswer: Nakki, ata mi tula darr mahinyala phone karen.
questions.translatedSentence: Definitely, from now on I will call you every month.
